items.title: RTX (RTX) Starts Building India Propeller MRO Facility
items.summary: RTX (NYSE:RTX) subsidiary Collins Aerospace has begun building India's first foreign-authorized propeller MRO facility in Bengaluru. The new site represents a multi million dollar commitment aimed at servicing regional commercial and military propeller aircraft across Asia Pacific. The facility is expected to support India's expanding aerospace ecosystem by providing in country maintenance capacity for local and neighboring operators.
